commands.command: set -euo pipefail; echo SECRET_NAMES; gh secret list --repo MichalMatu/tracker --json name --jq '.[].name' | sort; echo TESTER_KEYSTORE_PRESENT=$(gh secret list --repo MichalMatu/tracker --json name --jq 'map(select(.name == "TESTER_KEYSTORE_B64")) | length'); echo TESTER_KEY_ALIAS_PRESENT=$(gh secret list --repo MichalMatu/tracker --json name --jq 'map(select(.name == "TESTER_KEY_ALIAS")) | length'); echo TESTER_STORE_PASSWORD_PRESENT=$(gh secret list --repo MichalMatu/tracker --json name --jq 'map(select(.name == "TESTER_STORE_PASSWORD")) | length'); echo TESTER_KEY_PASSWORD_PRESENT=$(gh secret list --repo MichalMatu/tracker --json name --jq 'map(select(.name == "TESTER_KEY_PASSWORD")) | length')
